description: Fix broadcast push notification delivery race condition, add in-app notification center, synchronize offline artist stats to Supabase, polish leaderboard UX with podium styling, and compile sovereign release binary.

userStories.title: Fix Notification Permission Race Condition and Dispatch Fresh Broadcast
userStories.description: As a user, I want system push notifications to reliably appear when I launch the app or grant permissions, and receive fresh broadcast messages.
acceptanceCriteria: Dispatch fresh broadcast notification to Firestore notifications/broadcast with unique ID and rich music copy
SwaaraPushNotificationEngine does not mark notification as displayed if notification permission is denied or revoked
MainActivity re-triggers checkAndPostNotifications immediately upon POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission grant
Code compiles cleanly offline

userStories.title: In-App Notification Center and Live Broadcast Drawer
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view active broadcasts and announcements directly inside the app so I never miss updates even if OS notifications are disabled.
acceptanceCriteria: Add interactive notification bell icon to SwaaraHomeScreen top bar with unread badge indicator
Tapping bell displays In-App Broadcast Sheet showing announcement title, message, date, and action link
Mark announcement as read locally when dismissed
Code compiles cleanly offline

userStories.title: Synchronize Offline Artist Listening Stats to Supabase
userStories.description: As a listener, I want my offline artist listening duration to automatically sync to user_artist_stats when I sign in to Supabase.
acceptanceCriteria: SwaaraTopListenerManager.syncLocalStatsToCloud extracts all artist_*_sec and artist_*_plays from SharedPreferences
Upserts accumulated artist stats to Supabase user_artist_stats table alongside global_listening_stats
Gracefully handles network drops and avoids duplicate counting

userStories.title: Polish Leaderboard Screen with Podium Styling and Empty-State Fallback
userStories.description: As a listener, I want an engaging Hall of Fame leaderboard with podium badges and helpful fallback when an artist has no streams yet.
acceptanceCriteria: Distinctive podium styling for ranks 1 (Gold), 2 (Silver), and 3 (Bronze) in SwaaraLeaderboardScreen
Current signed-in user rank banner displayed prominently if user is on the leaderboard
Helpful suggestion fallback when searched artist has no recorded listeners
